<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="cmn_relative_duration"><cmn_relative_duration action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><name>SOCI Significant - Initial</name><script><![CDATA[// Perform relative duration calculation using the 'calculator' variable (which is a DurationCalculator object)

(function() {
    var paymentTime;

    // Work out if "current" is a Task record or Task SLA and then get the "date_time_became_aware" element from the Task
    var tableName = current.getTableName();
    if (tableName) {
        var baseTableName = GlideDBObjectManager.getAbsoluteBase(tableName);
        if (baseTableName == "task")
             paymentTime = current.getElement("parent_cyber_incident.date_time_became_aware");
        else if (baseTableName == "task_sla")
            paymentTime = current.getElement("task.parent_cyber_incident.date_time_became_aware");
    }

    //add application system property for ransomware onto the payment date time
    var ransomwareSLA = Number(gs.getProperty('x_1776078_cyber_0.sla.soci_significant_initial_hours')) * 3600;
    var notificationDueTime = new GlideDateTime(paymentTime.getGlideObject());
    notificationDueTime.addSeconds(ransomwareSLA);

    // if we've got a "breach date" and it's already breached, set the "breach date" to 1 second in the future
	var slaCreated = new GlideDateTime(calculator.startDateTime);
    if (notificationDueTime.before(slaCreated)) {
        slaCreated.addSeconds(1);
		notificationDueTime = slaCreated;
    }

    // set the endDateTime property of the calculator object
    calculator.endDateTime = notificationDueTime;
    calculator.calcScheduleDuration();
})();]]></script><sys_class_name>cmn_relative_duration</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-27 08:54:53</sys_created_on><sys_id>3383234c830f4f1044779cb6feaad372</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SOCI Significant - Initial</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Cyber Incident Management" source="x_1776078_cyber_0">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Cyber Incident Management">9c0eda15c31d03102d84f44ed4013148</sys_scope><sys_update_name>cmn_relative_duration_3383234c830f4f1044779cb6feaad372</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-27 08:59:06</sys_updated_on></cmn_relative_duration></record_update>
